_: Hand labels for Map 2 -- Apex Predators. Adds dark caves (which cost a torch to enter at night), four research tracks, colossal squid spanning 7 to 11 squares, and sharks that cost points. See tools/labels/map1.json for how this file is used.
kindNotes: 14 is a pair of two-pixel specks left over where a flag pole was cut at the play-area edge -- 'ignore' means it is deliberately not content, as opposed to not yet looked at.
paletteNotes: Entry 3, rgb(123,183,180), is the shaded water of the dark caves: enterable, but only in daylight or by spending a torch. Entry 4 is the purple of a colossal squid's body read through to the background, and entry 5 a lighter water wash.

colourSymbols._: The research magnifier is printed in one flat yellow used nowhere else. Three other things share the hue and each is excluded by shape rather than by colour: the bannerfish body is tall and narrow (0.3 wide by 0.5), a flag badge is larger (0.7 by 0.8), and the two depth lines run the full 22 cells across. A near-square blob of about 0.4 of a cell is a magnifier and nothing else. Twelve of the twenty icons are drawn on the colossal squid, where connectivity cannot reach them.
